top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards Balasubramanian and Klenerman for reversible-terminator sequencing-by-synthesis chemistry on clonally amplified clusters, a new chemical capability that is fully mature and has changed genomics and medicine. The two-name allocation rests on the committee record, with no unverified priority claim for a third laureate, and the citation states that the recognised discovery is nucleotide and surface chemistry. P002 (Buchwald and Hartwig, Pd-catalysed C-N coupling) is a clean, mature two-name prize but narrower in reach and close in kind to the 2010 prize, so it ranks second; a prize is preferable to no award.
